properties.name: A served skill designs a phenomenon and the experiment that tests it
properties.rationale: Anthony settled dec:idea-a-phenomenon-is-designed-model-equations-hypothesis-predictions-and-the-experiment-that-tests-them as "(d) then (a)": trial the sinogram reconstruction design as a phenomenon first, then write a served skill composing what exists. The trial (fact:the-sinogram-trial-laid-out-a-phenomenon-and-names-what-the-skill-must-say-2026-10-27) named what the skill must say, and #806 gave add_inference held_as so a model held on purpose is not reasoning not as stated. The recipe was run through the tools before it was written down, and two things it found are in the skill's honest limits as candidates for option (b): held_as is per call, so a step holding a model and a supposition takes two calls; and a result never refutes (it contests), while a claim it supports reads conditional on the held model with the result in rests_on_tests. Nothing checks that a prediction predates its result, and an idealization's regime is prose. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: New served skill design-a-phenomenon and its /design-a-phenomenon command: the observation given, the model and each law used as given held (held_as model / principle), each idealization its own premise with where it fails, a step per prediction and per dropped idealization, the hypothesis under test a supposition discharged into the prediction stated before the data, numbers through kept calculator records, discriminating experiments accepted before the data, results as evidence that support or contest, and a read-back with what it gives a journal article. design-a-proof and design-an-argument point to it; a wire test checks the recipe reads as the skill says; find_skills ranks it first for its job. Also corrects art:derived-edge-readers' count of judged readers (88 not_derived, not 64).
